parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: A User ID to filter the undisbursed challenges to a particular user

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of items to skip. Useful for pagination (page number * limit)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of items to fetch

parameters.name: completed_blocknumber
parameters.description: Starting blocknumber to retrieve completed undisbursed challenges

parameters.name: challenge_id
parameters.description: A challenge ID to filter the undisbursed challenges to a particular challenge
